look_here_first: Measure an intact OPEN flower: perianth about 2.5–5.5 cm total, far shorter than the 7–17 cm tube of A. longiflora. Check broadly triangular or delta-ovate leaves with usually truncate, rounded or somewhat heart-shaped bases; confirm ripe anthocarp ribs and small summit knobs. Tiny closed flowers are not comparable to fully open flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: POWO accepts Acleisanthes obtusa with native range southern Texas to northeastern Mexico and Jalisco. The settled review did not certify three project target counties; do not force PASS.

morphology_keys.habit: Perennial low-spreading or prostrate, sometimes scrambling branched herb or subshrub; flowering shoots can ascend or climb.
morphology_keys.leaves: Mostly opposite, often unequal pairs; blades generally delta-shaped to broadly delta-ovate, with truncate to rounded or shallowly cordate bases; margins mostly flat to slightly wavy.
morphology_keys.open_flower: Petaloid fused perianth, not a separate corolla; fully open perianth about 2.5–5.5 cm overall, narrow tube about 1–2 mm in diameter, spreading limb about 13–25 mm across.
morphology_keys.fruit: One-seeded anthocarp about 5–8 mm, with five ribs and deeper paired grooves ending in small inconspicuous glandless knobs; fruit length overlaps A. longiflora.
morphology_keys.reproduction: Solitary flowers or small 2–5-flowered cymes, and reduced cleistogamous flowers; presence of only closed flowers can conceal the larger trumpet.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. longiflora has an exceptionally long 7–17 cm open tube, narrower wedge-based leaves, and thin often translucent fruit ridges without the same rib-end knobs. Mirabilis differs in bracts/involucre and fruit structure; Boerhavia usually bears much smaller clustered flowers; Allionia has clustered showy flower units and distinct anthocarps.
comparisons.cautions: Synonyms A. berlandieri and A. greggii are not separate species cards. Leaf shapes and fruit lengths overlap, so prioritize measured OPEN flower tube and ripe anthocarp ridge architecture. White or pinkish flower color is not diagnostic.

diagnostic_image_needs: Open perianth side view with ruler and complete tube

Ripe anthocarp macro showing five ribs, grooves and terminal knobs
